github_state_rule: state is 'merged' when the snapshot merged flag is true, else the snapshot state ('open' only — pr_snapshot_from_payload collapses every non-closed state to 'open'; adapters/github.py:236).
gitlab_state_rule: state is 'merged' if raw state == 'merged', 'closed' if raw == 'closed', else 'open'; merged = (raw == 'merged'); draft = draft or work_in_progress is True (adapters/gitlab.py:384-387).
note: GitHub snapshot: title truncated to 500 chars, merged = merged or merged_at set. GitLab MR 'opened'/'locked'/'' all normalize to 'open' (verified).
